6031.title: ACP choice and companion fields remain separate questions
6031.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP planner creates one question per schema property, disables free text for enum choices, and declines the whole form when any property has no decodable answer.

prReviews.verdict: NOT VALIDATED — closed, static review only
prReviews.topFinding: Suffix-only folding is provider-wide and can omit a schema-required enum property on a custom-only answer; no branch or code from this PR was executed.

6031.proposedFix: Capture the installed provider request and accepted responses first; then implement provider-scoped companion folding with enum-safe response encoding, required-field handling, and controls for unrelated similarly named fields.
6031.caveats: Verified at the real planner boundary in two clean main checkouts, not in a live omp session or rendered UI. The installed omp request and accepted response contract remain unverified.
